params.amount: The offer's amount as the seller saw it.

params.price: The price the buyer saw; the purchase fails if the seller changed it.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

params.feeBps_: Platform fee in basis points, at most MAX_FEE_BPS.
params.monster_: Monster proxy (it must grant this contract its ESCROW_ROLE).
params.pot_: POT proxy, the currency of every trade.

params.newValue_: Initial value of the V2 variable.

params.expiresAt: Unix seconds; in the future, at most MAX_DURATION away.

returns.offerId: Id of the new offer (ids start at 1).

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). Emits a {RoleRevoked} event if the calling account had `role` and this call successfully revoked it. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

returns.listingId: Id of the new listing (ids start at 1).

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

BPS().notice: Fees and increments are in basis points: 10 000 = 100 %.

MAX_BID_INCREMENT_BPS().notice: Highest minimum bid increment the admin can set: 50 %.

MAX_DURATION().notice: Longest auction, longest fixed-price listing with an end, and longest offer.

MAX_EXTENSION_WINDOW().notice: Longest anti-snipe extension the admin can set.

MAX_FEE_BPS().notice: Highest platform fee the admin can set: 10 %.

PAUSER_ROLE().notice: Role allowed to pause and unpause new trades.

UPGRADER_ROLE().notice: Role allowed to upgrade the implementation.

acceptOffer(uint256,uint256).notice: Accepts an offer on the caller's monster: held in their wallet, or on sale by them (the listing         ends; refused if an auction already has a bid).

bid(uint256,uint256).notice: Bids `amount` POT on an auction: the POT move into the marketplace and the previous highest bidder         is refunded. A bid in the last `extensionWindow` seconds pushes the end back by that window.

buy(uint256,uint256).notice: Buys a fixed-price listing: `price` POT go from the caller to the seller and the fee recipient, the         monster to the caller. Needs a POT allowance of `price` for the marketplace.

cancel(uint256).notice: Cancels the caller's listing and returns the monster. An auction with a bid cannot be cancelled.         Works while paused.

cancelOffer(uint256).notice: Takes the caller's offer back (POT returned). Once an offer expired, anyone can call it and the POT         still go back to the buyer. Works while paused.

config().notice: Addresses and rules of the marketplace.

getListing(uint256).notice: A listing by id (status `None` if it never existed).

getOffer(uint256).notice: An offer by id (status `None` if it never existed).

hashTypedData(bytes32).notice: EIP-712 digest of a struct hash in this contract's domain (for wallets, the game and tests).

initialize(address,address,address,addre.notice: Initializes the proxy. Callable once. Auctions start with a 5 % minimum increment and a 5 minute         anti-snipe extension.

initializeV2(uint256).notice: One-off V2 setup, callable once and only on a proxy already initialized as V1.

listingOfToken(uint256).notice: The active listing of a monster (0 if it is not on sale).

makeOffer(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Offers `amount` POT for a monster, on sale or not. The POT move into the marketplace until the offer         is accepted, taken back or expired.

minNextBid(uint256).notice: The lowest bid an auction accepts now.

nonces(address).notice: Current signature nonce of an account (part of every signed message).

pause().notice: Stops new listings, purchases, bids and offers. Exits stay open (except POT moves while POT itself is paused).

sell((uint256,uint8,uint256,uint256,uint.notice: Puts a monster of the caller on sale. The monster moves into the marketplace.

setAuctionRules(uint256,uint256).notice: Sets the minimum bid increment (basis points of the highest bid) and the anti-snipe window         (seconds). Admin only.

setFee(uint256).notice: Sets the platform fee (basis points, at most MAX_FEE_BPS). Admin only. Applies to every sale         concluded afterwards.

setFeeRecipient(address).notice: Sets who receives the fees. Admin only.

setPrice(uint256,uint256).notice: Changes the price of the caller's fixed-price listing.

settle(uint256).notice: Ends a listing that reached its end; anyone can call it. An auction whose highest bid meets the         reserve is sold; otherwise the monster goes back to the seller and the bid to the bidder. Works         while paused.

totals().notice: Counters since deployment: listings and offers created, POT traded, POT of fees.

version().notice: Version of this implementation, bumped by every upgrade.
